title: Data Cleaning & Preparation
description: Sample data preparation workflow demonstrating how common quality issues can be identified, corrected and validated before analysis.
objective: Demonstrate a repeatable process for preparing structured data for reliable analysis and reporting.
steps: Inspected the dataset for missing, duplicate and inconsistent records.
Identified fields requiring standardization and validation.
Cleaned duplicate and incomplete records where appropriate.
Standardized values and formats for consistent analysis.
Performed quality checks on the prepared dataset.
results: Created a clean, structured sample dataset ready for downstream analysis and visualization.

challenges.problem: Inconsistent formats and incomplete records can affect the reliability of analysis.
challenges.solution: Used systematic validation and standardization checks before finalizing the prepared data.
